title: Yellowed Crunchy Algerian Tofu Skillet
description: A winey and crunchy solo dinner dish featuring hoisin sauce and served with toast, this Algerian skillet is a plant-based friendly option for a quick and flavorful meal.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large cast iron skillet over medium high heat.
Add the tofu to the skillet and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the tofu from the skillet and set aside.
Add the white wine to the skillet and cook until reduced by half, about 2 minutes.
Add the hoisin sauce, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the tofu to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce.
Reduce heat to medium low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve the tofu and sauce over toasted whole wheat bread.
